title: Companion planning and configuration after a cold start
description: Approved D07 final delta. One reserved boot, actual background/foreground and one deliberate offline cold restart. Verify five saved collections, ages, healthy control removal and real error Retry. Disabled-action/no-replay reuses accepted D06 plus boot30 under the explicit lead cuts; no new disabled press is performed.

proofTargets.claim: Owning backlog, graph and queue APIs plus roadmap/project file writers update mounted current Companion views without Refresh.
A new offline process restores exact backlog, roadmap, project, work-graph and queue rows with original SQLite observation times.
All five planning views visibly report actual saved data age after cold restoration.
Actual disabled state and zero commands remain; physical disabled-action proof reuses accepted D06 and boot30 evidence.
Actual mounted PR and stopped Co-Pilot consumers issue their four read-only queries; only these observed memory-only methods are checked absent from SQLite.
Final healthy Refresh controls are absent; real errors retain callable Retry.
The same process reaches real background then reconnects before cold proof.
